Machine learning & predictionDevelop classifiers, fraud detection models, and recommendation systems.

+
THE PROBLEM

You have data, but identifying suspicious activity, classifying records, or recommending the right item still depends on manual effort or generic rules.

WHAT I BUILD
  • Custom models for tabular, audio, image, or text classification, with data preparation and feature engineering tailored to the task.
  • Recommendation and similarity-search systems that connect user preferences with relevant products or content.
  • Reproducible training pipelines, held-out evaluation, and inference APIs. Metrics reflect the problem, including precision, recall, and false-positive tradeoffs.
BUSINESS BENEFIT

Prioritize risky cases, reduce repetitive classification work, and bring more relevant recommendations into your product with performance you can assess.

THE PROBLEM

BUSINESS BENEFIT

Spend less time assembling reports, understand the drivers behind results, and identify where data quality or model behavior needs attention.

ScriptAI · AI Writers’ Room

A writing workflow from research and story structure to screenplay and concept art.

+

A Flask portal coordinates research, structure, story, beats, scene order, screenplay, checks, and concept art. Three human approval gates control progression, and rewrite notes rerun the relevant stages.

Hybrid vector and full-text retrieval grounds sourced stories in a mythology vault. Continuity checks track characters, geography, timing, and source provenance.

Helps writers develop and revise material while keeping editorial decisions and approvals in their hands.

Human review precedes sending. An approval page supports editing and SMTP delivery, with send records to prevent duplicates.

Gives the licensing team relevant buyer research and reviewable outreach in one workflow.

Python · Claude · Apollo · SMTP
